fossil_filter.excluded_taxa: GBIF species that are not part of this checklist (which only contains extant taxa, so extinct / fossil species and amber inclusions are dropped)

meta.note: Only occurrences assignable to a taxon of this checklist are used: species maps from GBIF accepted species keys, genus/family maps also include records identified to the genus only. Extinct / fossil species in the same GBIF genus or family are excluded, and FOSSIL_SPECIMEN / MATERIAL_CITATION records are dropped. Per-genus record caps make this a reproducible sample, not a random one; presence-only data is strongly biased towards North America and Europe.
